description: Improve a project repository by writing clear documentation that helps another developer understand, run and contribute to it.
requirements: Repository should include a README.md file at the root
README.md should describe the project purpose, tech stack and main features
README.md should include setup and run instructions
README.md should include testing instructions or clearly state if tests are not available yet
README.md should include a simple folder structure or architecture overview
title: Document Your Project
